course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A smart home alarm system works as follows:
The alarm sounds if and only if either the motion sensor or the door sensor is triggered, but not both. Where, p: The motion sensor is triggered; q: The door sensor is triggered; r: The alarm sounds.
i) Translate the description into a logical expression using p, q, r.
ii) Construct the truth table for your expression.
iii) Is the system logically consistent? Explain your answer.
